title: ypwang.one — personal site, including "How Do Function Vectors Come into Being and Where Do They Live?"
description:
Snapshot of the source repository for ypwang.one, taken at the publication of the article How Do Function Vectors Come into Being and Where Do They Live? (read online).

The archive contains the article source, its 9 figures (SVG on the page plus PNG archival copies), the 11 data tables behind those figures as CSV, the site template, and three OpenTimestamps proofs: one anchoring the content as it stood before publication, one anchoring the published version, and one anchoring the version archived here.

Licensing: the article, figures and data are CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-CONTENT). The site template code is MIT (see LICENSE), from the Tufted Blog Template.
